ability.name: Nine-eyed Tome
ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls and banishment rolls for this unit.

ability.name: Ambition's End
ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. In addition, subtract 1 from casting rolls for the target for the rest of the battle.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Wizard^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.

ability.name: Wyrdflame Blade
ability.effect: If any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit by this unit’s combat attacks, that enemy unit has the **^^Burning^^** keyword.

ability.name: Arcane Siphon
ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• The target is banished.
• **Heal (X)** this unit, where X is the target’s Health characteristic.
ability.declare: Pick a visible **^^Manifestation^^** (friendly or enemy) that was not set up this turn and is within 12" of this unit to be the target.

ability.name: Mutating Blade
ability.effect: Pick 1 of this unit’s melee weapons. That weapon’s Attacks characteristic is 2D6 for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Spell-Catcher Amulet
ability.effect: This unit can use a **^^Summon^^** ability from the manifestation lore you picked during army composition. That **^^Summon^^** ability does not count towards the total number of **^^Spell^^** or **^^Banish^^** abilities this unit can use this phase.
ability.declare: This unit can use this ability if any enemy **^^Manifestations^^** were banished this phase.
